onboarding.title: First setup
onboarding.aiDescription: finsight uses your own Ollama instance for categorization and chat. You can change the model later in Settings.
onboarding.modelReady: Ollama is reachable. Select one of the installed chat models.
onboarding.modelUnavailable: Ollama is not reachable right now. You can continue and configure it later.
onboarding.modelRequired: Select a chat model or enter an Ollama model name.
onboarding.chooseInstalledModel: Choose an installed or recommended model
onboarding.customModelHint: The model and the preconfigured embedding model are downloaded in the background after you continue if they are not installed yet.
onboarding.modelWaiting: The models are queued. Waiting for Ollama …
onboarding.modelInstallFailed: Automatic model download failed. You can change the model later in Settings.
onboarding.webSearchDescription: When enabled, uncertain merchant names may be sent to an external search provider after amounts and common identifiers are removed.
onboarding.accountDescription: Add a read-only bank, broker or exchange connection. This is recommended, but you can continue without one.
onboarding.accountSyncStarted: The first synchronization has been requested. Accounts may take a moment to appear.
onboarding.accountSyncInProgress: The account is synchronizing. Approve the request in your banking app if you are prompted.
onboarding.accountSyncPending: The connection is saved. You can start synchronization later from Accounts.
onboarding.accountSyncTakingLonger: Synchronization is taking longer, but it continues in the background. You can finish setup and check its status later under Accounts.
onboarding.accountSetupFailed: The account connection could not be set up.
onboarding.accountSetupFailedHint: Synchronization failed or timed out. Remove the connection and set it up again with correct details.
onboarding.accountSetupRetry: Remove connection and set up again
onboarding.categoriesDescription: finsight starts with a set of common categories that you can adapt at any time.
onboarding.categoriesOptional: Customizing categories is optional. The defaults are enough to start synchronizing and categorizing transactions.

vault.setupSubtitle: Choose a master password. All bank credentials are encrypted with it. Without this password they cannot be read.
vault.unlockSubtitle: Enter your master password to enable connections and sync.
vault.recoverySubtitle: Enter your 12 recovery words and choose a new master password. Your financial data does not need to be re-encrypted.
vault.recoveryPlaceholder: Enter all 12 words in the correct order
vault.recoverySetupSubtitle: These 12 words are the only fallback if you forget your master password. They are shown once and are never stored by Finsight.
vault.recoveryWarning: Write the words down in order and keep them offline in a safe place. Anyone with this phrase and a copy of your database can unlock your financial data.
vault.recoveryFirstWordLabel: Enter the first word to confirm
vault.recoveryFirstWordMismatch: The first word does not match.
vault.recoveryConfirmLabel: Enter all 12 words again to confirm
vault.recoveryMismatch: The recovery phrase does not match.
vault.recoveryConfirmFailed: The recovery phrase could not be confirmed.
vault.recoverySaved: I saved and verified the phrase

connections.bankProvider: What would you like to connect?
connections.name: Display name

connections.deleteConfirm: Delete {{name}} and all locally imported data?

sourceHint.volksbank: Connect your existing online banking access.
sourceHint.generic_fints: Choose your bank next. The connection is configured automatically.
sourceHint.trade_republic: Your portfolio and settlement account are synchronized read-only.
sourceHint.binance: Use a read-only API key. Trading and withdrawals must remain disabled.
sourceHint.trading_212: Use an API key pair with the narrowest possible permissions. Finsight only performs read requests.
sourceHint.coinbase: Create a CDP API key with view permission. Finsight never uses trading or transfer operations.

fints.userHint: Use the ID you normally enter for online banking. Depending on the bank it may be called VR-NetKey, alias, login name, Legitimations-ID or user ID.
fints.customerIdHint: Only enter this if your bank explicitly provides a second customer ID in addition to your login ID. This field can usually remain empty.
fints.tanMediumHint: Only needed if several TAN apps or devices are registered in your online banking. Enter the name shown there; otherwise leave it blank.
fints.bankSearch: Search by bank name, city, BIC or bank code
fints.bankHint: Find your bank by name, city, BIC or bank code. The server address and other technical details are filled in automatically.
fints.bankRequired: Please select a bank from the search results.

assets.subtitle: Your invested positions – excluding account balances.

assets.estimatedHistory: Includes a reconstructed history based on the positions currently held. Purchases, sales and deposits during the period can affect the historical total.

assets.accountSyncInProgressHint: The connection is set up. Investment positions will appear here once synchronization finishes.

dataSettings.modelsHint: Choose chat and embedding models independently.
dataSettings.installModelHint: Enter a model name from the Ollama library. The download runs on your Ollama server and the model is selected for this role when complete.
dataSettings.embeddingChangeConfirm: Switch the embedding model? Embeddings for every transaction must then be recomputed. This runs in the background; transactions and categories stay unchanged.
dataSettings.modelChangeSaved: Model settings saved. Existing categories stay unchanged.
dataSettings.modelChangeSavedWithEmbedding: Model settings saved. Embeddings for every transaction are being recomputed in the background.
dataSettings.installChatConfirm: Download and select {{model}} as the chat model? Existing categories stay unchanged.
dataSettings.installEmbeddingConfirm: Download and select {{model}} as the embedding model? Embeddings for every transaction will then be recomputed in the background.
dataSettings.defaultModelsWaiting: Waiting for Ollama to install the default models
dataSettings.defaultModelsPending: Model installation starts after first-time setup is completed
dataSettings.defaultModelsFailed: Automatic download failed · choose a compatible model under Edit
dataSettings.categorizationWebSearchDescription: Allow uncertain merchants to be researched during categorization. Only a minimized search query is sent externally. Chat web search remains a separate per-request choice.
dataSettings.demoModeDescription: Amounts and balances are changed only in this view. Booking text, categories and dates stay intact.
dataSettings.demoModeActive: Demo mode is active: displayed money amounts are scaled. Original data stays unchanged; this is not encryption.
dataSettings.recoveryReady: Your twelve recovery words are an alternative key to the vault. If you forget your master password, you can use them to set a new one without re-encrypting your financial data. Keep the words offline and separate from this device.
dataSettings.recoveryUnconfirmed: The recovery phrase has not been verified and therefore cannot be relied on for recovery. Create and secure a new phrase.
dataSettings.recoveryMissingHint: The twelve recovery words act as an alternative key to your vault. They let you set a new master password if you forget it. Finsight does not store the words, so keep them offline in a safe place.
dataSettings.recoveryReplaceConfirm: Create a new recovery phrase? The previous words remain active until you verify the new phrase. Older backups retain the phrase that was active when they were created.
dataSettings.categorizeDescription: New transactions are categorized automatically. Use this to revisit existing automatic assignments after changing the model or category structure.
dataSettings.categorizeModalHint: Choose which transactions should be checked again. Manual assignments are preserved by default.
dataSettings.includeManualHint: This also removes and reevaluates your own category decisions.
dataSettings.recategorizeManualConfirm: Also reset manual assignments? Your own category decisions will be removed.
dataSettings.recategorizeQueued: Reset {{reset}} assignments, applied {{rules}} rules and queued {{queued}} for the local model.
